title: Maruti Suzuki just started making its own hydrogen - from power it used to waste
sources: Renewable Watch, September 2026 - Maruti Suzuki commissions green hydrogen plant in Haryana
Bioenergy Times, September 2026 - Maruti Suzuki commissions first green hydrogen plant at Manesar with 300 kW capacity
caption:
Maruti Suzuki just started making its own hydrogen. From solar power the factory used to simply waste.

On September 24, 2026, Maruti Suzuki commissioned its first green hydrogen electrolyser plant, at its Manesar factory in Haryana - a 300 kW facility that uses surplus solar power generated on factory holidays to split water into hydrogen, then blends it with natural gas as manufacturing fuel. The pilot supports India's National Green Hydrogen Mission and the company plans to scale the approach to other plants in Haryana and Gujarat.

Wasted power, turned into fuel - one factory's pilot for how Indian manufacturing decarbonizes at scale.
